product_one_liner.value: Malachyte helps ecommerce retailers personalize search, recommendations and product pages in real time using shopper behavior.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the navigation or footer, and /pricing returns 404.

named_customers.notes: Both appear with customer case-study links.

eng_blog.notes: The index contains product, funding and commerce-editorial posts plus one qualifying technical infrastructure article—not two engineering writeups.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes multiple setup, tracking and portal articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page explicitly states: “There are no open positions right now.”

model_provider.notes: The CEO describes a slower base model learning long-term taste and another head continuously adapting to session behavior.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims SOC II–Type 1 certification and GDPR compliance; GDPR is a compliance claim rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced August 6, 2026; co-led by Bessemer Venture Partners and Gradient Ventures, with Harpoon Ventures participating.

raised_18mo.notes: The $10 million seed round was announced August 6, 2026, within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page explicitly states that there are no open positions.

launched_6mo.notes: Coverage dated August 6, 2026 reports that the native Shopify integration became generally available in June 2026, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Di Lyngholm, VP of Product & Growth, moved from consulting to full-time in April 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: HubSpot and Apollo are examples of sales tools in job responsibilities; Salesforce is a supported integration. These signals do not establish confirmed internal deployment.
